title: pilosella balansae
intro: Pilosella balansae, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family, is a species of flowering plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella balansae include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's ability to modulate oxidative stress, inhibit microbial growth, and reduce inflammation.
